title: Large Language Model Assisted Transportation Planning through a Differentiable User Equilibrium Layer
abstract: arXiv:2610.16140v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transportation planning has traditionally required substantial expertise in network modeling, traffic assignment, and optimization. As a result, strategic analyses such as network design, capacity expansion, and model calibration remain inaccessible to non-expert decision makers. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) provide an opportunity to bridge this gap by enabling natural-language interaction with complex transportation planning tools. However, existing LLM-based systems primarily serve as interfaces to simulation software and lack the ability to efficiently search, evaluate, and optimize transportation solutions. This study proposes an integrated human-AI transportation planning framework that combines a large language model, a model context protocol (MCP) interface, an open-source transportation planning engine (AequilibraE), and a differentiable user equilibrium (UE) assignment layer. translated_title: 基于可微分用户均衡层的大语言模型辅助交通规划
translated_abstract: 传统上，交通规划需要具备网络建模、交通分配和优化方面的深厚专业知识。因此，诸如网络设计、容量扩建和模型校准等战略性分析对非专业决策者而言仍然难以触及。大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展为弥合这一差距提供了机会，使其能够通过自然语言与复杂的交通规划工具进行交互。然而，现有的基于LLM的系统主要充当仿真软件的接口，缺乏高效搜索、评估和优化交通解决方案的能力。本研究提出一个集成的人机协同交通规划框架，该框架结合了大语言模型、模型上下文协议（MCP）接口、开源交通规划引擎以及可微分用户均衡（UE）分配层。该框架使非专业用户……
tldr: 该研究提出一个结合大语言模型、MCP接口、开源交通规划引擎和可微分用户均衡分配层的集成人机协同框架，让非专业决策者能够通过自然语言高效完成交通方案的搜索、评估与优化。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an integrated human-AI transportation planning framework that combines an LLM, an MCP interface, an open-source planning engine (AequilibraE), and a differentiable user equilibrium assignment layer, enabling non-expert decision makers to efficiently search, evaluate, and optimize transportation solutions through natural language.
